component.name: gallery-dl
component.summary: Download image galleries from supported websites

description.p: gallery-dl is a command-line program for downloading image galleries and collections from supported websites. It provides configuration options, authentication and filename formatting.

This community package repackages the official Linux binary unmodified. Run it in a terminal with flatpak run io.github.mikf.gallery_dl --help. The application menu opens a terminal that prompts for gallery URLs and saves downloads to your Downloads folder. Press Enter at an empty prompt to close it. From the command line, your home folder is accessible and downloads go under the current directory, as with upstream gallery-dl.

External drives are not included: run flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media io.github.mikf.gallery_dl to add them. Reset custom permissions with flatpak override --user --reset io.github.mikf.gallery_dl. The runtime provides ffmpeg; optional tools such as yt-dlp are not included.
